confidence_notes: Medium overall, with uneven quality across anchors. Coffee, inexpensive meal, mid-range meal for two and beer come from web-search result summaries of aggregated, crowdsourced or modelled price pages (CityCost Oct 2026 update, MyLifeElsewhere, Expatistan, a French-language Querétaro cost page, Numbeo-derived Mexico national figures). I did not open the full pages, the sources disagree by roughly 20%, and beer is set toward the upper end of the range to reflect restaurant rather than shop pricing. No Querétaro-specific cocktail or wine-by-the-glass index was found. Cocktail and wine_glass are therefore low-confidence estimates based on the local relationship to beer (about 2.3x and 2.2x), with a dated TripBase cocktail figure as a loose cross-check; upscale hotel-bar menus were treated as outliers. The four accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Mexican mid-sized heritage and business cities. No accommodation searches or live listings were consulted, so they are the least certain. No seasonal adjustment was applied for July.
comparable_city_reasoning: Mid-sized central-highland Mexican colonial and business cities (e.g., Puebla, Guanajuato, Morelia, San Luis Potosí) as the regional basis, with lodging pitched slightly above those because of Querétaro's business and weekend-tourism demand. Food and drink are benchmarked to Querétaro aggregator figures and Mexico national averages.
